data.title: PG One
data.about:
The PG ONE residential complex is nestled in a serene community of Al Furjan with established family-oriented infrastructure and low-rise development.

It is a 17-storey building with studios and 1-2-bedroom apartments, as well as two-level 3-bedroom duplexes.

Each duplex has its own elevator, swimming pool, garden, staff room, and laundry room. Apartments with 1–2 bedrooms have a separate kitchen, a guest bathroom, and a balcony. All bedrooms have en-suite bathrooms and built-in wardrobes with sliding doors.

Residents of PG ONE will be able to relax on a private terrace on the top 17th floor of the complex. It has a lounge area with panoramic bird's eye views of the Dubai skyline, the sea, and Dubai Marina.
